preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array length n is an integer between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) for a in arrays)
preconditions.description: For each test case, every element in the array is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == max_possible_sum(a) for line, a in zip(stdout_lines, arrays))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the maximum possible sum achievable by applying the operation any number of times to the given array.
